source: Binance Spot REST API /api/v3 (exchangeInfo, ticker/24hr, klines, bookTicker, depth)
universe: TRADING spot pairs quoted in USDT, ASCII symbols, excluding stablecoins/wrapped assets, 24h quote volume >= 5,000,000 USDT at collection time
layer1: low during 2026-06-05..07-05 (BTC breakdown) above own Jan-Feb low
layer2: synthetic COIN/BTC close ratio 2026-10-08 above value 60 days earlier
caveats: Universe selected by liquidity on collection day: survivorship bias.
Thresholds (5M volume, 60/20-day windows) are ad hoc and unvalidated.
Order book figures are a single snapshot at 2026-10-09 07:21 UTC.
